label: bug
file: src/export/csv.ts

The issue is that the CSV export in src/export/csv.ts merges rows with the same date, amount, and description even if they have different currencies, causing one of them to be omitted. This is a bug in the CSV writing logic that needs to be fixed to consider currency as part of determining row uniqueness before merging.
